asset.name: Original Grounded Fixture
asset.intent_summary: An original, performance-aware fixture with plausible dimensions, construction, and restrained surface detail.

style_axes.proportion_strategy: Plausible real-world scale without heroic exaggeration.
style_axes.construction_plausibility: Parts should communicate how the object is assembled and used.
style_axes.shape_language: Restrained primary forms with readable, moderately softened edges.
style_axes.visual_hierarchy: Silhouette first, construction second, surface detail third.
style_axes.geometry_detail_density: Geometry owns silhouette and construction-scale features.
style_axes.wear_narrative: Deferred to an authored material or decal stage.

surface_targets.mid_frequency: Construction seams and secondary modeled parts.

budget.future_bake_path: UV unwrap and bake approved Blender procedural channels to destination-compatible PBR maps

human_acceptance_questions: Does the fixture read clearly and plausibly at its intended distance?
known_limits: This reusable example does not define a destination engine, collision, LOD chain, or texture bake.
